name: Broadcom

eyebrow.en: Broadcom Inc. · Common stock · Palo Alto, California
eyebrow.zh: 博通 · 普通股 · 加州帕洛阿尔托

title.en: Custom AI chips for Google, Meta and OpenAI, plus a software cash machine.
title.zh: 为谷歌、Meta、OpenAI 打造定制 AI 芯片，外加软件印钞机。

lede.en: Broadcom designs custom AI accelerators (XPUs) and the networking chips that connect them, and owns VMware. AI semiconductor revenue tripled to $16.7B last quarter and is guided to $21.7B next, with management talking about roughly $115B of AI revenue in fiscal 2027. Two guides in a row landed just below what the market hoped, and AI mix is pulling gross margin down.
lede.zh: 博通设计定制 AI 加速器（XPU）及连接它们的网络芯片，并拥有 VMware。上季 AI 半导体营收增至三倍达 167 亿美元，下季指引 217 亿，管理层提及 2027 财年 AI 营收约 1,150 亿美元。但连续两次指引略低于市场期望，且 AI 占比上升正在拉低毛利率。

s.zh: 一致预期下年每股收益 · GAAP 历史约 46 倍
AI 217 亿 · 营业利润率约 66% · 毛利率约 73%

s.en: Q4 FY26 · date not yet announced
s.zh: FY26 第四季 · 日期未公布

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock fell after both the June and September reports despite record AI sales, and is 27% below its June high.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。尽管 AI 营收创新高，6月与9月两次财报后股价均下跌，目前较6月高点低 27%。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Broadcom's fiscal year ends around November 1; VMware is included from Q1 FY24. The last bar is company guidance.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。博通财年约在11月1日结束；FY24 第一季起计入 VMware。最后一根柱为公司指引。

s.zh: 同比 +29% · 营业利润率约 84%
由 560 亿上调 · FY27 约 1,150 亿

p.en: AI revenue goes from $8.4B in Q1 to a guided $21.7B in Q4 FY26. Management laid out about $115B for FY27 and about $230B for FY28, and says supply is secured for FY27.
p.zh: AI 营收由 FY26 Q1 的 84 亿美元增至 Q4 指引的 217 亿。管理层给出 FY27 约 1,150 亿、FY28 约 2,300 亿的展望，并表示 FY27 供应已锁定。

p.en: Shipping TPUs for Google and Anthropic, OpenAI's first custom accelerator, and Meta's MTIA from Q4. XPU shipments rose more than 3.5 times in a year.
p.zh: 为谷歌和 Anthropic 出货 TPU，交付 OpenAI 首款定制加速器，Q4 起出货 Meta 的 MTIA。XPU 出货量一年增长逾 3.5 倍。

p.en: XPUs carry more memory content and lower margins than software. Gross margin fell 210 basis points to 75% in Q3 and is guided to about 73% in Q4.
p.zh: XPU 内存含量较高，毛利率低于软件。Q3 毛利率下降 210 个基点至 75%，Q4 指引约 73%。

p.en: The Q4 revenue guide of $34.8B came in just under the $35.0B consensus, and the stock fell about 5% after hours, as it did in June.
p.zh: Q4 营收指引 348 亿美元，略低于 350 亿一致预期，盘后股价跌约 5%，与6月如出一辙。

p.en: A handful of hyperscalers and AI labs buy most of the AI output. A delay in one program or a shift to in-house design would show up quickly.
p.zh: 少数超大规模云厂商与 AI 实验室买走大部分 AI 产品。任何一个项目延迟或客户转向自研都会迅速反映在业绩上。

p.en: Broadcom carries about $59B of debt against $24B of cash, mostly from the VMware deal, though free cash flow covers it comfortably.
p.zh: 博通债务约 590 亿美元、现金 240 亿，主要来自 VMware 收购，但自由现金流足以覆盖。

p.en: Guide: about $34.8B revenue, including $21.7B of AI semiconductors and $8.7B of software.
p.zh: 指引：营收约 348 亿美元，其中 AI 半导体 217 亿、软件 87 亿。

p.en: Broadcom expects production shipments of Meta's custom accelerator to begin this quarter.
p.zh: 博通预计本季开始量产出货 Meta 的定制加速器。

p.en: First quarter against the ~$115B FY27 AI outlook.
p.zh: 对照 FY27 约 1,150 亿 AI 展望的首个季度。

sources: Q3 FY26 results and Q4 guidance (Jain)
Market reaction to the Q4 guide (Depthgrid)
Price, market cap, beta and analyst targets: Yahoo Finance and Stocklake, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Broadcom Inc.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Broadcom Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q4 FY21 to Q3 FY26. Broadcom's fiscal year ends around November 1. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY21 第四季至 FY26 第三季共 20 个季度。博通财年约在11月1日结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Broadcom is one of the most cash-efficient large companies in the market: capex is tiny, so almost all operating cash becomes free cash flow. Quarterly free cash flow roughly tripled in two years, from $4.4B in Q2 FY24 to a record $13.7B in Q3 FY26, as AI revenue scaled on top of VMware.
read.zh: 博通是市场上现金效率最高的大型公司之一：资本开支极少，几乎全部经营现金流都转为自由现金流。随着 AI 营收在 VMware 基础上扩张，季度自由现金流两年内约增至三倍，由 FY24 Q2 的 44 亿美元增至 FY26 Q3 创纪录的 137 亿。

read.en: My base case assumes free cash flow near 45% of revenue, with revenue of $34.8B in Q4 (guided) rising to about $45B by Q3 FY27 on the AI outlook. That gives about $71B over four quarters. The main risk is timing: XPU programs are lumpy, and management has said deployment speed at customer data centers, not demand, sets the pace.
read.zh: 我的基准情景假设自由现金流约为营收的 45%，营收由 Q4 指引的 348 亿美元，按 AI 展望增至 FY27 Q3 约 450 亿，四季合计约 710 亿。主要风险是时点：XPU 项目起伏较大，管理层表示节奏取决于客户数据中心的部署速度，而非需求。

p.en: The $0.65 quarterly dividend costs about $3.1B a quarter; Broadcom usually raises it each December.
p.zh: 每季 $0.65 股息约 31 亿美元；博通通常在每年12月上调。

p.en: Repurchases are opportunistic: $7.85B in Q1 FY26, then $0.6B in Q2 and none in Q3.
p.zh: 回购视时机而定：FY26 Q1 回购 78.5 亿美元，Q2 6 亿，Q3 为零。

p.en: About $59B of debt, largely from the VMware purchase, which Broadcom has been refinancing and paying down.
p.zh: 约 590 亿美元债务，主要来自 VMware 收购，博通持续再融资与偿还。

p.en: AI revenue is guided to $21.7B in Q4, up 236% year over year.
p.zh: Q4 AI 营收指引 217 亿美元，同比增长 236%。

p.en: Infrastructure software brings in about $8.7B a quarter at roughly 84% operating margin.
p.zh: 基础设施软件每季约 87 亿美元营收，营业利润率约 84%。

p.en: Capex was $532M in Q3, under 2% of revenue.
p.zh: Q3 资本开支 5.32 亿美元，不足营收 2%。

bridgeEnd.en: Cash before buybacks and debt paydown, Aug 2027 (est.)
bridgeEnd.zh: 2027年8月现金，未计回购与偿债（估）

bridgeNote.en: In practice much of this would go to buybacks and debt reduction, as it has in past years.
bridgeNote.zh: 实际上，与往年一样，其中大部分将用于回购和降低债务。
